title: Databricks tracking auth: databricks://<profile> must resolve host from the named profile, not from a separately passed host
answers: Codex or MLflow tracing with databricks://<profile> authenticates against the wrong CLI profile when several profiles share one workspace host
Why does databricks:// tracking URI ignore which Databricks CLI profile I selected?
Where is the Databricks profile passed to the auth token command for tracing URIs?
How do I pass a host option alongside a Databricks profile in the tracing auth provider?
body:
Path: Handles tracking URIs of the form databricks://<profile> (also Databricks host and token settings) when building the auth provider for MLflow tracing; createDatabricksAuth in libs/typescript/core/src/auth/index.ts constructs the Databricks SDK Config that resolves the host, token and CLI token command.
Rule: Pass the resolved `host` variable into `new Config({...})` in createDatabricksAuth, not the raw `options.host`. The SDK then receives the profile and calls `databricks auth token --profile <profile>` instead of `--host <host>`, which is what distinguishes profiles that target the same workspace.
Symptom: With several Databricks CLI profiles pointing at one workspace host, Codex tracing configured with databricks://<profile> used the token of a different profile (the one the CLI matched by host), so requests were authenticated as the wrong identity.
Constraints: Applies to the databricks:// path. Requires @databricks/sdk-experimental 0.18.0 or later, which honours the profile in the CLI call; the regression test in libs/typescript/core/tests/core/auth.test.ts asserts the CLI is called with `auth token --profile` and not `--host`.
applies: TypeScript tracing auth for databricks:// tracking URIs; not the OSS or Kubernetes auth paths.
says: Tracing logs into the wrong user account when multiple profiles share a workspace.
Setting a tracking connection profile sends traces using credentials from a different profile.
Traces should authenticate using the selected profile rather than matching only by host.
Application trace logging connects as the wrong identity when switching between named profiles.
Ensure trace tracking respects the chosen profile when workspaces share the same URL.
